checkpoint_binding_contract: The local theorem concerns the supplied mathematical export; verify_checkpoint must independently bind it to the actual checkpoint before reporting actual-network fidelity
composition: Topological induction over every typed SSA instruction, followed by structural equality of the complete finite graph tail

domain.values: All finite real feature coordinates, including diagonal tokens, clipping boundaries and label ties

error.decoded_graph: identical partially-directed prediction, rejection trace and explicit DAG completion
error.pair_labels: identical under the same lowest-index argmax rule

interchange.compatible_interventions: Every subset of the 14 declared sites, each receiving its own finite real tensor of the identical batch/node/channel shape; independent source assignments are allowed
interchange.interchange_relation: The mapped post-intervention neural states and program states agree, as do final scores and graph decisions; all nonintervened mapped states and their differences from the unpatched execution agree.
interchange.neural_execution: All 14 declared modules occur on every supported forward path. Replacement does not count an omitted/unevaluated SSA primitive as execution coverage.
interchange.proof: The checked local equations commute with matching output overrides. Topological induction covers every combination without assuming shared source values or cancellation; all downstream ordinary divisors/logs remain defined for arbitrary finite replacement values at these sites.
interchange.read_write: Read by the row-major bijective grid/flat reshape; write by its inverse and return the overridden physical module output. For attention preserve the second tuple component.

local_relations.argument: Each serialized coefficient and bias is checked against the independently bound actual tensor; finite product-sums and equal-argument Tanh preserve equality for every real feature coordinate. Ordinary divisions use the positive frozen std, not protected CDIR.

Deleting zero diagonal terms gives exactly n-1 incoming/outgoing terms and n*(n-1) global terms. Source/target broadcasts preserve each indexed coordinate and concatenate in the actual six-block order.

All n*n query tokens remain; only the n*(n-1) non-diagonal keys/values enter every head. Their nonempty score set has an attained maximum, hence at least one exp(score-max)=1, sum>=1. The checked Q/K/V slicing and head transpose exactly implement scaled finite dot-product softmax followed by value aggregation and frozen output projection.

The population variance is mean of squared deviations, so variance+eps>=eps>0 and sqrt is positive. Every centered coordinate, learned scale and learned bias agrees with the actual LayerNorm definition. No additional clipping is inserted.

The full positive-denominator log-softmax computation is retained. exp(o-max(o))=exp(o)/exp(max(o)) proves its log-normalization equals the actual definition. Reverse-pair indices and the [0,2,1,3] class involution are checked exactly, as is the final real probability normalization. Equality of the full score/probability tensors preserves every label comparison, including ties.
local_relations.relation: factorized head, symmetry and graph probabilities

local_relations.argument: The five serialized function ASTs are independently matched to the approved actual source: classify, greedy cycle projection, DFS reachability, lexicographic topological order and one explicit rank-based DAG completion. The same finite loops and comparison branches receive equal probabilities. Equality covers tie, threshold and cycle-rejection branches; it does not identify ambiguous causal edges.

unsupported_or_uncovered: Raw statistical and do-response feature construction
True graph identification or an identified CPDAG
Unregistered physical graph sites or other mapping families
